title: Install Textmob
body: Keep Textmob one tap away with a faster, app-like experience from your home screen.

title: August is here 🎉
body: August is extra special for us. It’s the month Textmob was born back in 2024. Two years later, we’re still building, improving, and growing with you.

title: Keep browsing, even offline
body: You can now keep browsing Textmob when your connection drops. Cached content lets you continue where you left off and catch up when you’re back online.

title: Use less data
body: On limited data? Data Saver reduces media usage so you can spend less data while still enjoying your feed.

title: Share any Snap directly
body: Every Snap now has its own shareable link. Found something worth sharing? Send it directly to someone and take them straight to that Snap.

title: Find more with better search
body: Search has been rebuilt to make finding users, posts, Snaps, and hashtags faster and more relevant. Hashtags now also have dedicated pages for exploring related content.

title: A redesigned Hall of Fame
body: The Hall of Fame now puts more weight on quality, genuine engagement, and consistency instead of simply rewarding people who post the most.

title: A stronger Textmob
body: We’ve improved account security and strengthened our systems against spam and artificial engagement, helping keep Textmob more authentic.

title: Here’s to a better Textmob
body: A new month, a new chapter, and a better Textmob. Update the app and explore what’s new.
